commands.label: python_ast_exit1
commands.command:
python3 -B - <<'PY' > docs/evidence/fixture-recovery/final-journal-python-ast.txt 2>&1
import ast
import json
from pathlib import Path
paths = ["scripts/retain-native-helper-drain.py", "tests/ownership/native_helper_drain_retainer_test.py", "docs/evidence/fixture-recovery/final-journal-counterexample.py"]
trees = [ast.parse(Path(path).read_text(), filename=path) for path in paths]
retainer = next(node for node in trees[0].body if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef) and node.name == "Retainer")
recovery = next(node for node in retainer.body if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == "recovery_step")
calls = [node for node in ast.walk(recovery) if isinstance(node, ast.Call)]
final = next(node for node in calls if isinstance(node.func, ast.Attribute) and node.func.attr == "note" and node.args and isinstance(node.args[0], ast.Constant) and node.args[0].value == "RECOVERY_COMPLETE_RUN_STILL_FAILED")
close = next(node for node in calls if isinstance(node.func, ast.Attribute) and node.func.attr == "close")
assert final.lineno < close.lineno
entry = trees[0].body[-1]
assert isinstance(entry, ast.If) and isinstance(entry.test, ast.Compare)
assert ast.literal_eval(entry.test.comparators[0]) == "__main__"
handler = entry.body[1].handlers[0]
loop, exit_statement = handler.body[-2:]
assert isinstance(loop, ast.While) and isinstance(loop.test, ast.UnaryOp) and isinstance(loop.test.op, ast.Not)
assert isinstance(loop.test.operand, ast.Call) and loop.test.operand.func.attr == "hold_step"
assert isinstance(exit_statement, ast.Expr) and isinstance(exit_statement.value, ast.Call)
assert ast.unparse(exit_statement.value.func) == "sys.exit"
assert [ast.literal_eval(arg) for arg in exit_statement.value.args] == [1]
print(json.dumps({"status":"PASS_PYTHON_AST_ONLY","files":paths,"finalFailedJournalBeforeOriginalClose":True,"completedHoldThenExit":1,"oneRunEntryExecuted":False}))
PY
